outcome: Overlapping story PRs no longer conflict on .factory state. Story evidence is story-scoped (.factory/stories/<KEY>/), the active-story run pointer is worktree-local and untracked with phase derived from artifacts, events are one conflict-free file each (union merge driver retired), pr_ready ships in place with no archive move, and the PreToolUse/Stop hooks survive a merge — engaging a self-contained deny-list that keeps writes locked but permits git-native recovery instead of crashing, so a conflict-markered run.json or factory_lib can never trap a session again. Intake activates the new layout; legacy repos stay readable and pick it up via forge upgrade. Proven by a two-worktree merge simulation with zero .factory conflicts.
